'''Tol Ferin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] who served the company [[Tangan Industries]] as a [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]]. In [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]], Tangan appointed Ferin to run the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Menelath]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iol]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. He approached his job with unswerving loyalty to Tangan and he ran the city according to the company's instructions, which created tension between Ferin and [[Elexia Nis'tar]]&mdash;the [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of the city [[Haven (city)|Haven]]&mdash;who prioritized the interests of the colonists of Iol over those of the company. Ferin continued to run Menelath until around the time of the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TUR" />
